method: Direct public search/open inspection of thirteen complete item-level correspondence bodies on authorized Chabad.org/TheRebbe.org and Sichos in English pages. The known blocked crawler was not used.

metric_delta.note: Net eligibility is +13 source families and +39 propositions. Translations, secretarial drafts and the authorized adaptation are each tied to their underlying letter or draft family and must not become additional witnesses if another language manifestation is later added.

evidence_family_dedup.counting_rule: Each English translation is one manifestation of its numbered-letter family, not an independent witness from the original-language letter.
Each is explicitly a secretarial draft whose final sent version may have changed; a later final letter must be linked to the same family and compared before counting.
The adapted English page derives from the underlying Igrot Kodesh letter and is not a separate witness.

verification_scope: Thirteen complete visible publisher bodies were inspected. Two are explicitly secretarial drafts, one is an authorized adaptation, and ten are publisher translations or presentations. Original-language witnesses, incoming letters, cited works, contracts, financial records and outcomes were not independently verified.
rights_note: Only bounded non-verbatim Hebrew research paraphrases and precise item/paragraph locators were stored; no protected letter was copied in full.
quality_note: All propositions are source-grounded paraphrases. Financial and business statements are contextual historical guidance, not current professional advice; the Shabbos partnership item is not generalized into an individualized ruling; blessings are not treated as empirical outcome evidence.
